style: Slow, warm and intimate, like the opening of a documentary; a wry, knowing pause before reading the three replies flatly.
text: A hailstorm hits your street. You post the photo... and the replies roll in. "AI." "Fake." "Photoshopped."

style: Measured and serious, with quiet concern; let 'every platform strips it' land.
text: Anything can be faked in seconds now. So real moments get dismissed, fakes get believed, and the metadata that could have helped? Every platform strips it.

style: Warm, assured, a gentle smile; slow down and give weight to 'Proof, not just pictures.'
text: Meet Witness. Proof, not just pictures.

style: Calm, confident explanation with quiet wonder; unhurried.
text: Shoot in the Witness camera, and your phone's security chip seals the photo the instant you press the shutter: the time, the place, and proof it came from a genuine device. Even offline.
Before you share, on-device AI finds faces, license plates and house numbers to blur, and keeps your exact location private. None of it leaves your phone.

style: Steady, confident, a touch of satisfaction.
text: Then post it anywhere. An invisible watermark and visual fingerprints travel with the image, so even a cropped screenshot traces back to the sealed original, with every change listed.

style: Even and honest, with gravitas; slow on the last sentence.
text: Someone edits a license plate? Witness highlights exactly what changed. No proof at all? It tells you that too. Not proven isn't the same as fake.

style: Open and welcoming, simple and clear.
text: And anyone can check, on any phone or computer, right in the browser. No app. No account.

style: Grounded and empathetic, like a trusted advisor.
text: For the moments that really matter, like a fender bender or a move-out, Case mode builds the report for you, and shares it with an end-to-end encrypted link.

style: Quiet authority building to a confident, satisfying close; deliberate pauses between the final three short sentences.
text: Every proof is anchored on the Internet Computer, a neutral record no one can quietly rewrite. Witness. Capture it. Seal it. Prove it.
